item.title: From Compliance to Strategy: Rethinking the Role of Human Rights in National Security and Countering Violent Extremism
item.description: Integrating human rights as a core strategy—not merely a compliance requirement—is essential for effective and sustainable CVE efforts, strengthening security, public trust, and safer societies.

item.title: The Shield of Americas Gathering and an Amplified Strategy to Counter China in the Western Hemisphere
item.description: CSIS Americas Program Director Ryan C. Berg discusses key issues that should be on the agenda for the upcoming Shield of the Americas Summit.

item.title: $3.7 Billion: Estimated Cost of Epic Fury’s First 100 Hours
item.description: Operation Epic Fury costs nearly $900 million per day, driven by the large expenditure of munitions. Because most of this is not in the budget, the Pentagon will soon need to ask for more money.

item.title: Epic Fury: The Campaign Against Iran’s Missile & Nuclear Infrastructure
item.description: CSIS's Heather Williams, Tom Karako, and Kari Bingen discuss Operation Epic Fury and its implicatons for U.S. strategic forces.

item.title: Macron’s Île-Longue Speech: Updating France’s Nuclear Doctrine for a New Era
item.description: President Macron’s updated doctrine marks a watershed for European defense, with an increased French nuclear arsenal and a “forward deterrence” strategy that integrates regional conventional capabilities. It aims to provide the operational means for strategic autonomy.

item.title: Is Hezbollah Still a Threat?
item.description: Any U.S. successes against Iran can also help undermine Hezbollah. CSIS's Daniel Byman addresses key questions about Hezbollah's influence in Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Missiles of Iran | Missile Threat
item.description: Iran possesses the largest and most diverse missile arsenal in the Middle East. The CSIS Missile Defense Project unpacks Iran's current missile activity and capabilities.

item.title: Would Regime Change Solve the Iran Challenge? | State of Play
item.description: The CSIS Geopolitics and Foreign Policy Department unpack the lessons from regime change operations in the Middle East and beyond.
